common.name: Name
common.codeRule: Use capital letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter.

users.name: Name
users.createHint: The user signs in with this temporary password and must change it at once.
users.search: Search by name, username or phone
users.caption: Staff accounts
users.resetHint: The user's open sessions end and the new password must be changed at the next login.
users.unlockHint: The reason is recorded in the audit log with your name and the time.
users.tempPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, not only digits. Give it to the user in person.
users.deactivateHint: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until an administrator activates the account again. Their records stay.

roles.confirmHint_one: {{count}} change takes effect at once for every user with that role. The reason is recorded in the audit log.
roles.confirmHint_other: {{count}} changes take effect at once for every user with those roles. The reason is recorded in the audit log.
roles.protectedHint: Locked permissions keep administrators able to manage users and roles.

settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 1 MB. Stored on this server.
settings.printTitle: Header and footer of printed documents
settings.printHint: Choose a document and paper size, then edit its texts.
settings.defaults: Not saved yet: these are the defaults.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.hint: Numbers restart every year. Counters advance only when a document is issued.

policies.payFirstHint: Always on. A service before payment needs a documented perform-first authorization.
policies.partialPayment: Allow partial payment of an invoice
policies.partialPaymentHint: Lines are settled in invoice order as money arrives.
policies.transferAlertDays: Alert on transfers pending more than (days)
policies.transferAlertHint: Verifiers are notified about bank transfers not yet confirmed.
policies.discountLimitsHint: Highest discount in percent of the patient share. Empty means no discount.
policies.performFirstHint: Each authorization is recorded with a reason, the approver and the time.
policies.dispenseRemainder: When stock runs short at dispensing
policies.remainderDefer: Keep the rest open to dispense later
policies.remainderRefund: Cancel the rest and refund the patient
policies.estimatedCostHint: Only doctors with the permission see it.

departments.doctorHint: Choose a user who holds the doctor role (create the user first).
departments.consultationServiceHint: Billed automatically when a visit with this doctor opens.
departments.scheduleHint: Sessions of the same day may touch but never overlap.

reasons.label: Reason
reasons.codeRule: Capital letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.

categories.writeoff: Payer rejection: rebill or write off

catalog.kindFixed: The type of a service never changes.
catalog.nameRequired: Enter an Arabic or English name.

prices.addListHint: Prices are added in dated versions after the list is created.
prices.newVersionHint: Starts as a copy of the version effective on that date. Prices can be edited until it starts.
prices.bulkHint: Creates a new dated version; the current prices stay as they are.
prices.percentHint: 10 raises prices by 10%; -5 lowers them by 5%.
prices.percentRule: Enter a percentage such as 10 or -5.5.
prices.kindsHint: Leave all unchecked to change every service.
prices.noVersions: Add the first version to enter prices.
prices.locked: It has started, so its prices may be on approved invoices. Create a new version to change prices.
prices.priceRule: Enter an amount such as 15000 or 2500.50.
prices.firstVersionHint: The first version of a list. Copy the current prices of another list to start from, then adjust them. A version that starts today is fixed at once, so it needs copied prices.
prices.copyFromHint: The current version of another list is copied into this one.
prices.copyRequiredToday: A version that starts today needs copied prices. Choose a list, or start tomorrow.

payers.addHint: Add the contract, coverage rules and exclusions on the next screen.
payers.datesRule: The contract cannot end before it starts.
payers.rulesHint: The most specific rule applies: a service, then its type, then the payer default.

ruleKinds.ceiling: Payer pays up to a ceiling

payers.amountRule: Enter a number such as 70 or 2500.50.
payers.preApprovalHint: The payer's approval reference is required on the line.
payers.exampleIncomplete: Fill in the rule to see how a line splits.
payers.exclusionsHint: Excluded services are never covered: the patient pays all of them.

rules.title: No coverage rules yet
rules.description: Without a rule the payer covers nothing: the patient pays the whole price. Add a default rule, then rules for kinds or single services.

exclusions.title: No exclusions
exclusions.description: Everything a rule covers is covered. Exclude a service or a kind of service the contract does not pay for.

departments.title: No departments yet
departments.description: Departments group rooms, doctors and services. Add the first one.

rooms.title: No rooms yet
rooms.description: Rooms are where doctors see patients. Add one and link it to a department.

doctors.title: No doctor profiles yet
doctors.description: Give a user with the doctor role a profile to set their department, consultation fee and weekly clinic times.

reasons.title: No reasons in this list
reasons.description: Staff pick from this list when they need to give a reason. Add the first one.

payers.title: No payers yet
payers.description: Insurers, companies and other payers that share the bill. Add one with its contract dates.

services.title: No services yet
services.description: The services, tests and items the center bills for. Add the first one.

priceItems.title: No prices in this version
priceItems.description: Services without a price here cannot be billed to this list. Add the services and their prices.

priceItemsLocked.title: No prices in this version
priceItemsLocked.description: This version is in effect and cannot change. Create a new version to add prices.
